m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Can I help you? Advice on attracting a Sky Squid? Sure: Don't. But for argument's sake, I'd probably use a Flying Glowfish as bait.
The Flying Glowfish's bioluminescence makes them stand out in the murky Aethyr, but it's their pungent odor - *oof* -  that Sky Squids can't resist.
Of course, catching a Flying Glowfish is even harder than catching a Sky Squid, so you'd want to create a massive Flying Glowfish lure.
But even if you could create a lure that big, that shiny, that stinky, you'd still never reel in a Sky Squid. They swallow everything whole!
What did Valantis say? We gotta make the Pod look like a Flying Glowfish? I assume it's gotta glow then? And stink? Of course it does.
I am familiar with Flying Glowfish. Their basic anatomy should be easily replicated with the debris at our disposal.
I saw Lightning Bugs in the Jungle. We could use some of their bioluminescent Venom to paint the Pod.
What? Oh, so everyone just assumes the pig knows how to generate stink? Lucky for you I did see Stinkreeds in the Jungle.
OK. Wizard, you get Lightning Bug Venom and Stinkreed Nectar. Sparck, you collect scrap for the fish façade. The three of us will ready a Pod.
About time! The Pod is prepped and ready for its makeover. Did you get the Venom and Stinkr- WHOOOAAAAUGH!
*Sniff* Ooo, that Stinkreed Nectar is... ripe.
And that's enough Venom to make us visible from Wysteria.
Sparck has the scrap 'fish parts' collected. Just put the silly thing together already, would ya, Wizard?
Look, we don't have to like each other, but we do have to trust each other. At least for now. Are you sure this will get us into Sepidious?
I've programmed a return Streamportal inside the Ark, so we only need to use this odiferous contraption once.
Given the assets we had to work with, I'd say it's a perfectly serviceable Flying Glowfish facsimile.
If by 'facsimile' you mean vehicle of our collective doom, then, yeah. It's great.
The entire Spiral is doomed if this ruse fails. Wizard, a word?
We must stop Medulla before he can build his own Essence Cannon. Sparck, configure a Pod to stream us to Medulla's hidden fortress.
It won't be easy - Medulla's hiding inside Sepidious, the biggest Sky Squid in Empyrea. The lair is built into the bowels of the beast!
Impossible. Sepidious is smaller than the sky islands of Empyrea. I cannot target the Cyclolabe on such a narrow point.
Additionally, Sepidious is in constant motion. Our Pod will miss its target and we will be obliterated in the Aethyr storms.
Then we make <ITALICS>us </ITALICS> the target. We can stream the Pod into a pocket of moderate safety within Sepidious' general area.
From that position, we simply need to attract the giant soaring cephalopod. Sepidious has to eat something - we can be that something!
Perhaps that alluring angler, Valantis, knows what kind of foods Sky Squids find most appetizing?
Can't say I love the idea, but I've got nothing better. Wizard, go ask this Valantis for advice on luring Sky Squids.
I used to have a gadget for luring Sky Squids, but I left it in my other belt. So just go with the pig's plan and consult Valantis.
